# Content change register — run 2

One entry per substantially changed or new page.

## CC-01 — `docs/get-started/quickstart_walkthrough.md` (generated by `scripts/docs/build_quickstart_walkthrough.py`) — Stage 01

| Field | Record |
|---|---|
| Original purpose | Notebook-style classification walkthrough organised by API step (B1–B10) |
| Problems | QS-A to QS-F (stage 01 report): API-ordered; no calibration motivation; intuitions stated as facts; forbidden conjunction wording; no weight mechanism; guarantee of the pair not separated from the merged estimate |
| New purpose and audience | Level 1–2 learners: follow one case (case 2) from raw output to a calibrated explanation, and learn what can and cannot be concluded |
| Nature of rewrite | Substantial: 10 core teaching sections plus optional A–C; all prose rewritten or re-checked; new cells (raw accuracy, raw extremes, raw vs calibrated table, Brier comparison, weight sum, feature exclusion of the strongest feature) |
| Scientific sources | Vovk, Petej and Fedorova 2015 (Prop. 1); Brier 1950; scikit-learn documentation; CE source (`calibrated_explainer.py:368`, `discretizer_config.py:53`); teaching-first specification `05` rev. 2 and mechanisms `04` |
| Examples | All outputs regenerated by execution; values equal the specification's independent re-execution |
| Deep references added | Semantics page, How CE Calibrates (ADD-1), guarded concept, where-to-go-next table |
| Validation | Strict build 0 warnings; content guard tests; prose-number guard in the generator |
| Remaining limitations | Conjunction reading and grey-band reading need the authors (SR-14); the "pair guarantee" wording is marked under review (SR-03) |
